caption: The drawing features three representations of a single shoe: two in simple outline above and one detailed colored rendering below. The colored shoe is a low-heeled, closed-toe design with an almond-shaped toe, depicted in a pale green fabric featuring a faint floral or patterned texture. It has a decorative strap or bow across the instep. The heel is medium height, curved, and tan or beige in color. The two upper outlines show the shoe from the top: one reveals the placement of the strap and bow, while the other focuses on the inner structure and shape. The background is a light beige color, and the artist’s signature, "M. Concha," is placed in the lower right corner.
title: Woman's Shoe
